_readme: Who the monthly job looks up on OpenAlex. Only entries with "confirmed": true are fetched. An entry is confirmed once it has been checked against the member's profile on research.ugent.be (same ORCID, or the same papers in UGent Biblio; see "checked"). Members left at false have no ORCID or Biblio list there to check against, so ask them to look at https://openalex.org/<id> and confirm before switching them on: a wrong profile puts a namesake's papers on the website. Harvey Friedman is left out on purpose: the obvious OpenAlex match is a different person (a biologist). A paper that is not the group's, typically a namesake's filed under a member's profile, goes in "exclude": give its OpenAlex work id (the W... number in https://openalex.org/W...) and a note saying why. It then never appears, however often the list is refreshed.
